baidu-search-sldjs 1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated the SKILL.md description for brevity: "Open browser and search for keywords. Use when user wants to search online."
- No functional code changes noted; documentation update only.

- Initial release of baidu-search-sldjs skill.
- Opens the default browser and performs web searches using Baidu with user-provided keywords.
- Designed for situations where users request Baidu searches or web search results.
- Simple invocation: provide keywords, and the skill opens search results in the browser.
